paragraphs.text: Anthousa is a legendary warrior on the plane of Theros .

During a conflict between Karametra and Keranos , Anthousa was caught in a deadly storm. Keranos, knowing of Karametra's favor for her close advisor, awoke an ancient titan to kill the warrior. With Nylea 's assistance, Anthousa managed to slay the creature. Karametra then bestowed supernatural strength on Anthousa, allowing her to cut the titan's head from his body.
When the Lachrymosa was stealing children and turning them into Returned , Anthousa swore she would track her down and put an end to it, although she was beaten to it by a force sent from Meletis .

A devout worshiper of Karametra , Anthousa serves as Leina Tower's leader, as well as commander of the goddess's Council of Warriors. When Karametra is away from Setessa , Anthousa acts as the ruler in her stead.
